The '''Shadren system''' was located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] linked it to the [[Belsmuth system/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef]], [[Katraasii system/Legends|Katraasii]], [[New Bornalex system/Legends|New Bornalex]], [[Sheris system/Legends|Sheris]], and [[Solaest system/Legends|Solaest systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Shadren [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the celestial body [[Shadren V]], which hosted an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] base during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="GG10" /> At some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which mentions that the [[attack on the Shadren V Imperial Navy base]] took place a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] prior, is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Alliance carried out<ref name="GG10" /> a successful<ref name="TEA" /> [[Attack on the Shadren V Imperial Navy base|attack]] on the base.<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadren system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
